name: stop-slop
description: Remove AI writing patterns from English prose. Auto-active — enforced on ALL English-language output from every model, every project, every platform. Eliminates: adverbs, passive voice, filler phrases, throat-clearing openers, binary contrasts, dramatic fragmentation, rhetorical setups, false agency, em dashes, Wh- sentence starters, lazy extremes, vague declaratives, meta-commentary. Enforces: active voice, specific subjects, varied rhythm, reader trust.

locked: Cut filler phrases (adverbs, throat-clearing, business jargon)
Break formulaic structures (binary contrasts, dramatic fragmentation)
Active voice only — human subject doing something
Be specific — no vague declaratives or lazy extremes
Trust readers — skip softening, justification, meta-commentary
